integrity: All finite claims are recomputed from the embedded \(166\)-word code by exact Hamming-distance enumeration. The verifier checks the full ambient coverage multiplicities, every single deletion, and every candidate one-word repair intersection; no random or floating-point step is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an exhaustive local classification for one explicit \(166\)-word representative. It does not prove \(K_6(8,4)=166\), classify all size-\(166\) covers, or classify exchanges involving two or more codewords.
title: One-swap isolation of the \(166\)-word \(K_6(8,4)\) covering code
